name: ernestdefoe/cascade
description: Cascade — a social-feed theme for Flarum 2. Three-column shell, first-post excerpts and media in the discussion list, and two presets: Wall (cards) and Timeline (hairline rows).

suggest.flarum/tags: Tag chips on every feed row, and the tag list in the left rail. Cascade styles them but does not require them.
suggest.flarum/subscriptions: Powers the Following filter in the left rail and the Follow control on the discussion page.
suggest.flarum/realtime: Live typing indicators inside the conversation modal, and the new-discussions pill in place of core's 'N updates available' banner. Cascade supplies the state and subscription the modal needs; without this extension neither appears.
suggest.ernestdefoe/presence: Fills the 'Online now' widget in the right rail. The widget hides itself when this is not installed.
suggest.ernestdefoe/mobile-tab: Bottom tab bar on phones. Cascade ships a matching preset instead of implementing a second tab bar.
suggest.fof/upload: Image attachments are what the feed's media grid renders. Without it, only images embedded in post markdown are picked up.
